note: People born in the United States Virgin Islands are United States citizens and hold its passport, at its fees.

sources.title: United States Code, 2023 edition (govinfo.gov), 8 U.S.C. § 1406, Persons living in and born in the Virgin Islands
sources.said: all persons born in those islands on or after February 25, 1927, and subject to the jurisdiction of the United States, are declared to be citizens of the United States at birth.

sources.title: United States Code, 2023 edition (govinfo.gov), 22 U.S.C. § 212, Persons entitled to passport
sources.said: No passport shall be granted or issued to or verified for any other persons than those owing allegiance, whether citizens or not, to the United States.
